_readme: The ONLY allowed source for claims about AP Villas properties in blog posts. Anything marked TODO must not be stated in a post. Pre-filled from villas.html, contact.html and about.html on 2026-10-10. Edit this file to change what the blog is allowed to say.

shared_facts.distance_to_mahakaleshwar: All five villas are within 2 km of Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, about 6 minutes by car or 12 minutes on foot (owner confirmed 2026-10-10)
shared_facts.distance_to_ujjain_station: About 3 km from Ujjain Junction railway station
shared_facts.mahakal_shuttle: Complimentary villa-to-Mahakaleshwar shuttle for in-house guests (up to 5 guests per trip)
shared_facts.bhasma_aarti_help: Caretaker explains the Bhasma Aarti booking process (online or counter) on arrival evening; shuttle drops guests at the temple gate by 3:30 AM for the 4 AM aarti. The help is complimentary; the temple's own permit is booked by the guest.
shared_facts.game_coupon: The Mahakal game on the website gives a 5% to 30% coupon; the guest can use it on the stay (direct booking) or on the food bill, one coupon per booking; each retry in the game lowers the discount it can earn by 5% (owner confirmed 2026-10-14)
included_in_every_villa: Full modular kitchen with microwave and cookware
shared_facts.food: Every villa has a full kitchen so families can cook; a local cook can be arranged for simple home-style thalis on request
shared_facts.cancellation_policy: Standard dates: free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. Festival dates (Mahashivratri, Shravan Mondays, Kumbh/Simhastha): full advance, non-refundable. Exact policy confirmed on WhatsApp.
shared_facts.check_out_time: 9:30 AM (one hour is kept for cleaning before the next check-in; a later check-out can be arranged on request, subject to availability)
shared_facts.guest_reviews: 4.9 star average; 200+ verified 5-star reviews across Airbnb, Booking.com, MakeMyTrip and Google (as stated on the site)
shared_facts.kitchen_detail: Separate kitchen or kitchenette with all cooking equipment, induction cooktop, microwave and mini fridge, so Indian families can cook their own meals during a darshan trip
shared_facts._amenities_note: Pets, wheelchair access, lift, power backup, AC, geysers and kitchen details were confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-10 as applying to the collection.
